programme.title: Mutant X: En ras från varandra
programme.desc: Mutant X möter en ny grupp nya mutanter som kallas Strand och leds av den mäktiga första mutanten Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på rakhyveln
programme.desc: När Mutant X och Genomex fångas på film när de använder sina krafter måste de båda ta itu med reportern som planerar att publicera informationen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Det förflutna som en prolog
programme.desc: I ett desperat försök att rädda sitt eget liv återupplivar Ashlocke en gammal egyptisk alkemist som utgör ett dödligt hot mot Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kärlekens bok
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Milano i Italien för att leta efter Casanovas försvunna Kärleksbok.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Myten om labyrinten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Claudia besöker Aten i Grekland för att leta i Minotaurus labyrint efter den legendariska gyllene tråden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kejsarens brud
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Moose Bay i Alaska och letar efter en kinesisk kejsarinnas sarkofag av vit jade. Sydney stöter på sina kolleger Dallas Carter och Kurt Reiner, som också är relikjägare.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Efterliv och döden
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Kairo, Egypten och sedan i Amsterdam. De måste besegra den rivaliserande relikjägaren Avery Ko till farao Thutmoses diamant innan den skärs upp och säljs.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik från en avlägsen trumma
programme.desc: Tyr kraschlandar Eureka Maru på en Nietzscheansk planet och får minnesförlust. Han måste komma ihåg vad han gör innan nietzscheanerna upptäcker honom och hans låda med stöldgods.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper får kunskapens gåva från en döende perseid, men upptäcker att perseiden var eftersökt av en prisjägare som nu har riktat sin uppmärksamhet mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvångsperspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan arresteras för att ha mördat en diktator för 300 år sedan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summan av dess delar
programme.desc: Andromeda bordas av en drönare från Consensus of Parts, ett mytiskt mekaniskt samhälle. Drönaren är vänlig till en början, men försöker tvinga skeppet att ansluta sig till Consensus.

programme.title: Mutant X: Det nya århundradets brott
programme.desc: En pojke som håller på att utveckla nya mutantförmågor har kidnappats och teamet går med på att hitta honom åt sin mamma. De får senare veta att det var hon som lät kidnappa sin son.

programme.title: Mutant X: Mörk Stjärna Resning
programme.desc: Teamet möter några personer som försöker bryta sig in i ett Genomex-laboratorium och upptäcker att de är vilda djur.

programme.title: Mutant X: En vitare nyans av blek
programme.desc: En ny mutant med förmågan att vara osynlig arbetar mot både Eckhart och Adam, trots att hon var involverad med Adam i det förflutna.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dubbel syn
programme.desc: En gammal vän till Brennan lockar honom och Emma i en fälla. Emma slutar med att splittras upp i två separata enheter, en god och en ond.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nio liv
programme.desc: Alla som stjäl en staty som föreställer den egyptiska kattgudinnan Mafdet dödas. Nu har statyn försvunnit och Sidney och Nigel har fått i uppdrag att hämta den.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel åker till Skottland för att hitta den andra ringen i Calums och Elenas par av Twining Rings.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Återuppsättningen
programme.desc: Kuba, Afrika 100 e.Kr: Wootes dyrkare förbannar hans idol för att skydda den. 2000: Ross Crawford kommer till Sydney eftersom han tog idolen och förbannelsen har påskyndat hans åldrande.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Dödens dolk
programme.desc: Indien, 500 e.Kr: En dyrbar dolk används vid människooffer till gudinnan Kali. Sydney måste återlämna en relik till Indien för sin jägarkollega, som tror att dolken fick honom att döda sin assistent.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skräck och avsky i Vintergatan
programme.desc: Gerentex är tillbaka och han kräver att Trance och Harper hjälper honom med sin nya plan: att hitta Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Mystikens Storbritannien: Mysteriet med den röda damen
programme.desc: Ullliga mammutar, trollstavar, gamla trollformler, gömda i Storbritanniens äldsta grav.

programme.title: Amerika i färg: Vilda västern
programme.desc: Från Buffalo Bill till konstruktionen av Hooverdammen, detta är historien om Amerikas vilda västern, i färg.

programme.title: Aerial America: New York City 24
programme.desc: Ta en 24-timmars tur över staden New York och upptäck vad som krävs för att hålla igång denna megastad dag och natt.

programme.title: Städer från ovan: San Francisco 24
programme.desc: Sväva över fantastiska broar, Alcatraz, "Painted Ladies" och mer på denna 24-timmars flygtur över San Francisco.

programme.title: Amerika i färg: 1930-talet
programme.desc: Se förbudstidens slut och Nya givens början, när Great Plains blir till damm, som du aldrig sett det tidigare: i färg.

programme.title: Zooveterinärerna: Klor, tassar och fenor
programme.desc: Titta in i den oförutsägbara miljön på akutmottagningar bakom kulisserna i vårt lands största djurparker.

programme.title: Luftens krigare: Spitfire
programme.desc: Kom med och bevittna hur jaktplanet Spitfire tog hem några viktiga nyckelsegrar för friheten under andra världskriget.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men of Advertising: 1950-talet
programme.desc: Se hur annonskampanjer från 50-talet lanserade nya amerikanska traditioner och löftet om en ljus morgondag.

programme.title: De förlorade banden
programme.desc: Se uppgången och det tragiska slutet för medborgarrättsaktivisten Malcolm X, fångad i arkivfilmer som sällan visats.

programme.title: Storbritannien i färg: Churchill
programme.desc: En inblick i Winston Churchills karriär, från hans episka misslyckanden till stora framgångar, presenterad helt i färg.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men of Advertising: 1960-talet
programme.desc: Undersök 60-talets reklamskapare och hur de använde humor och ironi för att nå ny publik och revolutionera branschen.

programme.title: An American Aristocrat's Guide To Great Estates: Herrgården Newby Hall
programme.desc: Upptäck vad som krävs för att underhålla nyklassiska interiörer och prisbelönta trädgårdar i Yorkshires Newby Hall.

programme.title: Apollos månfärder: Raketfeber
programme.desc: Från Sputnik till Mercury Seven, från JFK till chimpansen Ham, möt nyckelfigurerna från rymdkapplöpningens första år.

programme.title: Aerial America: Yellowstone
programme.desc: Följ med på en flygtur över Yellowstones branta berg, upplev sprutande gejsrar och titta på regnbågsfärgade källor.

programme.title: Städer från ovan: Miami 24
programme.desc: Flyg över Miamis stränder, hamnar, parker och nattklubbar och träffa de män och kvinnor som håller igång staden.

programme.title: An American Aristocrat's Guide To Great Estates: Slottet Sudeley
programme.desc: En titt på vad som gör Englands Sudeley Castle till ett av landets mest efterfrågade platser för bröllop.

programme.title: Mystikens Storbritannien: Sökandet efter Kung Arthur
programme.desc: Han är Storbritanniens mest legendariska konung... men existerade han verkligen?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Holland
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression. The capacity-filled audience kept the athletes battling to the finish.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Latvia
programme.desc: Last year in Latvia saw the first SCL win for local ‘Titan’ Dainis Zageris. This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year’s injury in Romania, as well as World champion in Log lifting Vidas Blekaitis and the yellow shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Serbia
programme.desc: In a very sunny 30 degrees atmosphere, deep in the mountains of Serbia, the SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for stage 6 of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Eleven, including former champion Martin Wildauer.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Bulgaria
programme.desc: Plovdiv, Ancient, second-largest city in Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the Strongman Champions League. Current leader in World Series is Matjaz Belsak, the youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL England 2016
programme.desc: At Guildford Spectrum - a one stop leisure facility where you can enjoy ice skating, ten pin bowling, swimming and a whole range of sporting.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Finland
programme.desc: Strongmen from all over the globe came to city of Vaasa in Finland, which is famous for its so-called ‘white nights’ to test their strength in the 9th stage of Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Romania part 1
programme.desc: Sibiu, Romania hosted the new stage of Strongman Champions League Romania, a two-day, seven-event battle with lots of spectators, 27-degree weather, and sunny skies…a fantastic strongman experience.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Romania part 2
programme.desc: After the first day of competition in Romania, Alex Moonen is leading, Martin Wildauer is in second, and Bjorn Solvang in third place. The thirst three events in Part two of the competition showcases a new challenge – Hercules hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Curacao
programme.desc: On first look, this is perfect place for vacation before the World grand finals - beautiful Ma and Bo beach in Curacao. It is 30 degrees, beautiful weather and beautiful people.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Portugal
programme.desc: It’s the last chance to qualify for the World grand finale of the Strongman Champions League. Dainis Zageris and Matjaz Belsak fight for the better position for the finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: World grand finals Dubai – Part 1
programme.desc: Dubai is the best place in the World to crown the new World champion in the MLO Strongman champions league for 2016. During the year, more than 100 athletes competed in 14 stages all over the world in the biggest strongman league of the world.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: World grand finals Dubai – part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, the best athletes compete in the Pole push, Deadlift, Forward hold and Loading. The location for the day two of MLO Strongman Champions League 2016 World Finals will be the Skydive Dubai Center.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Norway: The Strongest Viking 2017
programme.desc: SCL Norway: The Strongest Viking 2017 takes place in the mountains above the little village of Vinstra, placed in the beautiful valley of Gudbrandsdalen. It is the first of 16 stages of the MLO Strongman Champions League 2017.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League: SCL Germany: FIBO
programme.desc: The highly anticipated second stage of the Strongman Champions League, taking place in Germany, sees the strongest men competing in exciting duels as the SCL introduces new rules at this event: 14 athletes start in each competition.

programme.title: On the Case: Tangled Web
programme.desc: A romantic Valentine's Day rendezvous ends in murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Knock on the Door
programme.desc: A beautiful young mother is found murdered in the bedroom of her home. The only witness was her five year old son. Would he be able to help police solve the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: In order to solve the vicious double murder of a beloved couple, police must uncover a cold blooded killer's carefully calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: A Tangled Past
programme.desc: When a daughter investigates her sick mother's death, she begins to wonder if the cause of her untimely end was really murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Tip 1960
programme.desc: 19 year old Katie Poirier was working the night shift at a Convenience store when she was violently kidnapped. The abduction was captured on videotape but the images were not clear enough to identify her attacker.

programme.title: On the Case: Painful Memories
programme.desc: A young marine comes home and finds his nine month pregnant wife savagely beaten in their bedroom. Was he an innocent victim or could he have been responsible for the terrible crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Field of Nightmares
programme.desc: A young mother and son are found shot to death in a quiet Texas field. Would a mysterious bag left at the crime scene hold the key to catching their killer?

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder in Pelham
programme.desc: A daughter spends 25 years pursuing the truth behind her mother's mysterious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Where Evil Lies
programme.desc: A 25-year-old aspiring model vanishes, and the only clue police have is her empty car found near a cemetery.

programme.title: On the Case: No One To Trust
programme.desc: A beautiful young girl vanishes on a desolate stretch of highway. Could the man in charge of the investigation be responsible?

programme.title: On the Case: Solemn Vows
programme.desc: A mother finds her daughter savagely murdered inside their family owned wedding chapel.

programme.title: On the Case: Message In Blood
programme.desc: When police arrive at the scene of a grisly murder they wonder if the victim's dying act would point them to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programme.desc: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programme.title: On the Case: The Day After Christmas
programme.desc: A man and his girlfriend are attacked by a mysterious intruder in their home. Despite near fatal wounds, she survives and helps investigators solve the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game. Were the stakes too high? Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

programme.title: On the Case: River of Tears
programme.desc: Paula examines the discovery of a young woman's lifeless body on the bank of a shallow river. A note in her pocket may point to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Gone in an Instant
programme.desc: In Lenexa, Kansas, young women disappear from their apartments as police piece together evidence showing the terrifying crimes are connected.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Ball O'Snags
programme.desc: An engine fire and series of mechanical gremlins has Buffalo scrambling to make its Christmas deliveries. Newest rampie Prefkar Mony struggles with life in the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day. Prefkar escapes Hay River courier duty. Cory finds an original bracket for the DC3 static line for Mikey's D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dogfight
programme.desc: Buffalo's top guns, rookies and vets, go to California for aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. Cory and Mikey race to get ready for the D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot Scott faces his worst nightmare when a faltering Curtiss C-46 Commando engine and low fog force a scary landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Pre-Christmas Rush
programme.desc: Christmas is just around the corner, but Buffalo's crucial food and mail runs come to a halt. An engine seizure strands Scott, AJ and the C-46 plane, creating a chaotic chain reaction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into transatlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey. It's up to engineer Adam to get the C-46 crew out of a jam on a remote airstrip in minus 40.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Suspension
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years. It's also a setback for Jeremy and the other rampies, which takes a turn for the worse with an unexpected injury.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cause for Celebration
programme.desc: AJ and Candace get married in the Ice Castle. A frustrated Chuck tries to get the Electra to pay her way. A flummoxed Mikey tries to bake a cake for Joe's birthday.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Transatlantic Crossing
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks

programme.desc: En kvinna reser tillbaka ett år i tiden till julen innan hennes förlovning bröts och försöker reparera det som gick fel. Hon upptäcker att detta är ett utmanande företag.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays
programme.desc: Medan hotellchefen Georgia hanterar sina romantiska förbindelser med kocken och en stilig prins, får vi en inblick i livet för de andra gästerna och personalen på Hotel Maison i New York.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy säljer sin avlidna fasters välgörenhetsorganisation. Men Otto, som brukade arbeta som volontär där, vill anordna en sista välgörenhetsjulmiddag.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte hamnar i koma efter en olycka, men hennes själ är vaken. Inför en omröstning om ett fastighetsprojekt måste hon få sin stad och byggherren att ändra sig, samtidigt som ingen kan se eller höra henne.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: På julafton önskar Becky att hennes familj verkligen skulle lyssna på henne. Alla hennes tankar och frustrationer börjar komma ut när hon oavsiktligt börjar berätta för alla vad hon verkligen tycker.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Just Say Yes
programme.desc: Ashley ger Bar ett svar men ett gammalt familjedrama kan lägga sordin på drömmen. En stressig flytt hotar att förstöra Jades nystart. Luis ber att få träffa Stella för första gången på månader, så Bri måste bestämma vad som är bäst för hennes dotter.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Making It Official
programme.desc: Scotty T kommer tillbaka och 'gör ett inhopp' när han bjuder med alla på ett våghalsigt äventyr men under tiden är det spänt i huset medan Holly väntar på Kyles beslut. Har hennes förflutna förstört deras chanser till en framtid eller?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
programme.desc: Mike är inte längre huvudperson och Angelina öppnar sig för de andra.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Maci storgrälar med Ryan om vårdnaden om deras son Bentley, medan Amber och Gary försöker hitta ett sätt att ta hand om Leah tillsammans trots kontaktförbudet.
programme.sub-title: Teen Mom Finale Special: Check Up With Dr. Drew Part 1

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Kaitlyn Farrington
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av "Ridiculousness" kommer guldmedaljören Kaitlyn Farrington till Rob, Sterling och Chanel för att prata om "De andra Sotjispelen", "Petfobi" och vad det innebär att vara "LARP-oskuld".

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Rob's Parents II
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' tar Rob, Chanel och Steelo emot Robs föräldrar för lite 'Patdiculousness'med mamma, storhetsdåd med 'Genes gener' och lär sig att den största striden är 'Pappa mot blöja'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal V
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness försöker Rob, Steelo och Nina Agdal ta reda på varför 'Grabbar älskar farligheter', rulllar mat-tärningen och förlorar i 'Det har gått ut' och njuter av vyn från de billiga platserna i 'Läktarbeteende'.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: Hej då, tjejen
programme.desc: Alla går på fest för att Jeremiah ska få nåt annat att tänka på än sin farfars död. Men Nilsa blir full och förstör kvällen genom att starta ett storbråk med Aimee. Candace och Kortni planerar en tjejresa för att ställa allt till rätta.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: Exposed
programme.desc: När Josh och Lenns dyker upp riskerar saker och ting att vändas upp och ner i Lake Havasu. Och när Jeremiah tar dem åt sidan för att prata enskilt, triggas Gus svartsjuka. Gänget spelar några rundor Grand Theft Golf Car.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Answer to the Big Question
programme.desc: Resan till Algarve närmar sig sitt slut. Louis handlingar fortsätta skapa bråk i gänget, och Holly får äntligen svar på frågan som alla har ställt sig.
programme.sub-title: The Answer to the Big Question

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: My Favorite Mistake
programme.desc: Nilsa får veta att ett gammalt misstag kan komma på besök. Aimee är nu ökänd och rädd för att visa sig ute i PCB. Candace måste lämna strandhuset i förtid.

programme.title: Laguna Beach: Fast Cars & Fast Women
programme.desc: When LC, Stephen and Trey check out a designer fashion show in LA, LC watches Stephen's attention turn from fashion to fashion models.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CLXXXVI
programme.desc: I ett rykande färskt avsnitt av Ridiculousness löser Rob, Chanel och Steelo in sina poletter för 'Arkadspelsaction', stöter på några 'Intensiva individer' och går vilse i ett 'Telefontöcken'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' provar Rob, Steelo och Carly Aquilino några 'Nya steg', några 'Snattade outfits' och snyggar till sig med 'Djärva accessoarer'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Swizz Beatz
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av "Ridiculousness" utmanar Rob, Chanel och Steelo den legendariska producenten Swizz Beatz att "Välja sitt gift", köra old school med några "Hårda knuttar" och försöka undvika "Konstiga misslyckanden".

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Season 9 Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Jenelle pratar om sin sista säsong i TM2, Kail och Vee minns sitt tumultartade förflutna, Briana konfronterar Devoin, och Chelsea berättar om sina problem efter förlossningen.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Samantha är en söt och glad tjej som alltid sköter sig och gör sin läxor, men som gör sin familj otroligt besviken när hon följer i sin mammas fotspår och blir mamma i tonåren.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' hälsar Rob och Steelo Nina Agdal välkommen och ser faran i vitögat i 'Skräcken med åtta ben', tillbringar tid i 'Det farligaste rummet' och beger sig till byggplasen i 'Byggskador'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: G-Eazy
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo och Chanel sällskap av rapparen G-Eazy för att lära sig 'Ensamtidens faror', njuta av 'Nästan det goda livet' och uppleva smärtan i att 'Smaka på dissen'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CDVI
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' diskuterar Rob, Chanel och Steelo de som är *Hedersfåglar', vad som är 'Positiv kraft' och hur vi alla kan bli 'Slumpens hjältar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Johnny Knoxville
programme.desc: Filmstjärnan Johnny Knoxville hjälper Rob att presentera Makeshift Ramps, Freak Beasts och Poorly Placed Kids. Du får även chansen att skratta åt några Hot Messes och Blown out Gens.

programme.title: Laguna Beach: The Last Dance
programme.desc: It's two weeks before prom and the Laguna Beach high schoolers are trying to figure out who they will take on their big night out. While hanging out at Morgan's house, Kristin shares that she has a secret admirer.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and B. Simone II (UK)
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness hälsar Rob och Steelo B.Simone välkommen för att träffa viga katter i 'Kattninjor', upptäcker att inte alla skönhetsbehandlingar är bra i 'Nedpiffningar' och blir skadade på vackra ställen i 'Vacker värk'.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Temptation of the Keto Guido
programme.desc: Snooki ertappas med att stjäla från en strippa, Vinny blir frestad att synda, och Pauly D letar kärleken.
programme.sub-title: The Temptation of the Keto Guido

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness duckar Rob, Steelo och gästen Camille Kostek för bubbelte-kulor i 'Bubbelte-bullseye', råkar ut för olyckliga nunchacku-träffar i 'Nuncha-kastrerade' och halsar öl med de bästa i 'Episka ölkillar'.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: Miss La Vela
programme.desc: Gus födelsedag slutar i katastrof när polisen griper Kirk. Tjejerna planerar en ny överraskningsfest för Gus för att kompensera för den misslyckade kvällen. Rumskompisarna samlas för att stötta Candace och Nilsa i en bikinitävling.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on how the criminal justice system handles minors who are tried as adults for serious crimes.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Tacoma Confidential
programme.desc: A report on corruption and a cover-up by city officials of Tacoma, Washington, focusing on David Brame, the city’s police chief who rose to power despite a shady past.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Law and Mrs. Shelton
programme.desc: A report on Catherine Mehaffey Shelton, a criminal defense attorney from Dallas. She has been practicing law in Texas for nearly three decades and making headlines for nearly as long, primarily because strange things happen to the men in her life.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: A report on problems which arise when children under the age of 17 receive unwanted sexual letters on the Internet, focusing on Lindsay, a 14-year-old suburban Florida girl who began receiving explicit love letters from a stranger in Greece.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Secret Life of Eric Wright
programme.desc: In 1980, Kathi Spiars met a man who called himself Steve Marcum, and shortly married him.
programme.sub-title: The Secret Life of Eric Wright

programme.title: 48 Hours: For Love or Money?
programme.desc: Celeste Beard claims she is innocent of the murder of her husband Steven Beard, co-founder of an Austin television station. After a life of abuse and depression, Celeste married Beard. In October 1999, Beard was fatally shot while lying in bed.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Who Killed the Prosecutor?
programme.desc: Steve Tauzer, a prominent assistant district attorney in Kern County, CA, was found murdered in his garage. Chris Hillis, a former police officer, a colleague and friend of Tauzer, was arrested for the murder. Chris’ son Lance was key to the case.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Missing Molly
programme.desc: A report on the unsolved abduction and murder of 16-year-old Molly Bish. Bish disappeared in June 2000 from the local swimming hole. In May 2003, Tim McGuigan, a former police officer, helped discover evidence that lead to the discovery of Molly’s body.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Family Accused
programme.desc: A report that focuses on cases where people accused of sexually abusing children were tried and imprisoned based on little real evidence other than the testimony of young children.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on the brutal 1994 murders of the Rafay family - Sultana Rafay, her husband Tariq and their autistic daughter, Basma - in Bellevue, Washington, focusing on the pursuit and arrest of the two primary suspects.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Burden of Proof
programme.desc: Following the disappearance, in Jan. 1997, of 33-year-old Beverly Watson, her husband, Jim, became a prime suspect. Watson insisted that he was innocent. Police noticed that Jim was wearing makeup to conceal what appeared to be scratches on his face.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Confession
programme.desc: A report on the 1998 murder, of 12-year-old Stephanie Crowe. The girl's 14-year-old brother Michael, and his two friends confessed to the killing. Their attorney claims that the confessions were false and the result of police coercion.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Why Did Eric Kill?
programme.desc: A report on Eric Smith who in August 1993, at age 13, was convicted of murdering four-year-old Derrick Robie. The child’s body was found strangled and battered with rocks near his home in Savona, N.Y.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets of the Well
programme.desc: Reports on two separate unsolved murders with strange similarities, both solved by Georgia criminal investigator Clay Bryant. 1) a report on the murder case of Gwendolyn Moore 2) The disappearance of fire chief Fred Wilkerson.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Driven to Extremes
programme.desc: Mary Hill was driving three teens, when her BMW crashed and killed two of them. Hill claims she lost control as the car sped up on its own, but investigators say she was driving recklessly. Hill was charged with vehicular homicide and manslaughter.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Prescription For Murder?
programme.desc: In Chester, S.C., 12-year-old Chris Pittman fatally shot his grandparents, stole money, weapons and his grandfather’s truck and set fire to the house. Having confessed to the crime, Chris was convicted of murder and sentenced to 30 years in prison.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in the Hamptons
programme.desc: A report on the October 2001 murder of Wall Street tycoon Ted Ammon who was embroiled in a bitter divorce battle with his wife Generosa who later died of breast cancer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: When Vicki Wegerle, the mother of two young children, was strangled in 1986, her husband Bill was considered by many to be the prime suspect. For the next 18 years police lacked evidence to charge Bill, or anyone else with Vicki’s murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Natalee Holloway: New Clues In Paradise
programme.desc: A report on new details into the search for Natalee Holloway, a U.S. teenager who disappeared on May 30, 2005 during a post-graduation trip in the Caribbean island of Aruba.
programme.sub-title: Natalee Holloway: New Clues In Paradise

programme.title: 48 Hours: Scared to Death
programme.desc: Police Lt. Jim Barton found his wife, Vickie, murdered execution-style on their farm in Warren County, Ohio, in 1995. With limited physical evidence and no suspects, the investigation lay dormant for nine years until a tip opened the case.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Terror at the Morgue
programme.desc: Dr. O.C. Smith, a medical examiner, was apparently attacked on June 1, 2002, as he was leaving work. He was found wrapped in barbed wire with a bomb strapped to his neck. Dr. Smith survived but expressed concern that his assailant might attack again

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Phil och Catherine börjar sin bilresa i Bristol, där Catherine besöker metodistkyrkans äldsta kapell. De kör genom Clifton och in i Somerset i sin lilla röda Morgan Roadster.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Phil Serrell och Catherine Southon är på andra etappen av sin roadtrip. De reser genom Dorset och in i Hampshire i en sportig röd Morgan Roadster. Phil träffar volontärer som håller minnet av krigsveteraner levande.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon och Phil Serrell kör genom soliga Surrey och Hampshire på den tredje etappen av sin resa.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon och Phil Serrell kör genom Buckinghamshire och Hertfordshire i en klassisk Morgan Roadster på den fjärde etappen av sin roadtrip. Catherine besöker British Film Institute National Archive.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon och Phil Serrell kör runt i Essex i sin Mercedes cabriolet och samlar antikviteter. Phil reser tillbaka i tiden till 1920-talet för att lära sig mer om uppfinningen av radion.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Antikvitetsexperterna Raj och Irita börjar sin antikresa i soliga Suffolk. I Lowestoft får Irita lära sig om en lokal hjälte.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Den andra etappen av Raj och Iritas road trip tar dem runt Northamptonshire. Irita stannar upp tillräckligt länge för att lära sig om den före detta slavskeppskaptenen som skrev Amazing Grace.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Borta bland antikviteterna får Irita lära sig om Storbritanniens enda kvinnliga Nobelpristagare i kemi. Raj besöker en sportklubb i Bristol för att spela bordtennis.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2504
programme.desc: Efter att ha smakat på Devonshire cream tea får Raj höra om en stor äventyrare av mannens son, medan Irita njuter av några folksånger och får höra hur de sparades för eftervärlden.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Raj gör några stora fynd i en liten butik och beger sig till en berömd taverna för att lära sig mer om guizing. Irita hittar en målning som påminner henne om hennes barndom.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Charles Hanson och Natasha Raskin Sharp reser genom Northumberland i den äldsta motor som någonsin varit med på Road Trip. Charles besöker Morpeth för att lära sig mer om kampen för kvinnors rösträtt.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2507
programme.desc: Charles får veta varför Whitby inspirerade Bram Stoker och Tasha besöker Bempton Cliffs för att lära sig hur en lokal präst kämpade för att skydda fågelägg.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2508
programme.desc: Charles orsakar kaos i antikvitetsbutikerna innan han upptäcker ursprunget till Yorkshire Pudding. Tasha besöker Leeds för att lära sig mer om en banbrytande filmskapare.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2509
programme.desc: Charles besöker ett bageri för att prova en lokal delikatess. Tasha är mer försiktig med sina pengar och får höra talas om en nigeriansk prins som gick med i RAF under andra världskriget.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2510
programme.desc: Charles tillbringar mycket tid innan han besöker en av de stora konstsamlarnas hem. Tasha reser till Ware för att lära sig mer om en kväkarpoet.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2511
programme.desc: Margie besöker världens äldsta fungerande camera obscura medan Tim besöker ett romerskt fort som är perfekt bevarat i torv.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2512
programme.desc: Förutom att se en massa härlig natur får vår duo veta mer om den mystiska St Bees Man och hur viktig karpen i Windermere är.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2513
programme.desc: Bilresa blir båtresa när duon besöker Isle of Man. Efter att ha letat antikviteter på ön besöker Margie Tynwald-parlamentet och Tim tar en tur med världens äldsta hästdragna spårvagn.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
programme.desc: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
programme.desc: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Born to Walk
programme.desc: Al flunks his written drivers test the same day that Kelly passes hers, leading him confined to the house and unable to get to the racetrack to bet on an important horse race.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Alley of the Dolls
programme.desc: Victory seems assured when Steve agrees to join the Bundys for a family team bowling match against Peggy's arch rival from high school, Mimi, and her obnoxious family.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: Steve returns home having grown a beard from a week-long rafting trip. He and Marcy get into a huge argument over his reluctance to shave it off, leading him to move in with the Bundys.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How do You Spell Revenge?
programme.desc: Al, Peggy and Bud are part of a shopping mall softball team playing other mall teams. After losing a few too many games, Al demands that Peggy improve her softball skills or she is off his team.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Earth Angel
programme.desc: There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York. Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: You Better Watch Out
programme.desc: The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back, but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Build a Better Mousetrap
programme.desc: Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Master the Possibilities
programme.desc: Al, under the impression that you don't have to pay for anything you didn't order, takes Peggy and Bud on a wild spending spree when the mailman accidentally leaves a new credit card addressed to Buck the dog.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Blonde and Blonder
programme.desc: On Valentines Day, Kelly hauls in a load of Valentines, while Steve plans to give Marcy a trip to Hawaii. When Marcy finds out from Peggy, she plans to give Steve his Valentine present by jumping out of a life-size cake.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Great Escape
programme.desc: The Bundy's stay at the shoe store after their house is tented for termites. A grounded Kelly plots to escape and go to a rock concert.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent
programme.desc: Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Just Married…with Children
programme.desc: While secretly going through Steve and Marcy's mail, Al and Peggy fill out an application to a TV game show called "How Do I Love Thee" where the objective is a Bundy natural: surviving physical torture from one's spouse.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Father Lode
programme.desc: After going with Steve to the racetrack, Al is reluctant to reveal that he won $1,200, because he knows that Peggy and the kids will take the money for themselves.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
programme.desc: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
programme.desc: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.
programme.sub-title: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
programme.desc: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'm Going to Sweatland
programme.desc: When a perspiration stain on one of Al's shirts resembles a silhouette of The King of Rock & Roll, the Bundy household becomes a hot spot for Elvis Presley fanatics to visit.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)
programme.desc: A young football player, named Matt, from Polk High where Kelly and Bud go to school is threatening two Bundy records. One held by Al for the most touchdowns in one season, and the other by Kelly for refusing her advances.
programme.sub-title: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Dump of My Own
programme.desc: Al decides to build a spare bathroom when the upstairs toilet floods one too many times.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Her Cups Runneth Over
programme.desc: Al must go to a far-off lingerie outlet store to buy a discontinued brassiere for Peggy.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Bald and the Beautiful
programme.desc: Desperate Al and Steve put their heads together seeking solutions to impending baldness.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'll See You in Court
programme.desc: In the infamous 'lost episode', Al and Peg learn they have been video-taped getting intimate at a sleazy motel. The same thing has also happened to Steve and Marcy. They decide to take the matter to court.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Gypsy Cried
programme.desc: After a birthday party fortune teller predicts luck for everyone else but doom for Marcy, she insists the Bundys fly with her on her business trip where she confronts her rude boss.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Requiem for a Dead Barber
programme.desc: After the death of his longtime barber, Al lets his hair down rather than tolerate a visit to a stylist or a salon... staffed by women. When Al backs down and goes to a salon, he gets a really bad hairstyle that makes him look like a woman.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Eatin' Out
programme.desc: The Bundy's go out to a fancy restaurant to spend an inheritance check for $237 from a late uncle of Peggy's. But it becomes apparent that the fine dining in public is not a part of the dysfunctional Bundy lifestyle.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: My Mom, the Mom
programme.desc: Kelly invites Peggy to her school as part of a presentation for career day.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Can't Dance, Don't Ask Me (aka Kelly's Dance)
programme.desc: After Kelly gets in trouble at school, the only way she can get out of punishment if she joins the school's tap-dance club.
programme.sub-title: Can't Dance, Don't Ask Me (aka Kelly's Dance)

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Three Job, No Income Family
programme.desc: Al finally convinces Peggy to contribute to the household income but feels emasculated when Peggy starts bringing home more money than Al from her cosmetics sales job. Even Al's new part-time job at Burger Trek can't put him back as the breadwinner.
programme.sub-title: A Three Job, No Income Family

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Harder They Fall
programme.desc: While driving Peggy back from the video store, Steve gets cut off in traffic and Peggy gives the driver "the finger." The Bundys to come over to Steve’s house as protection when he's afraid of a violent reprisal after being followed home by the man.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The House That Peg Lost
programme.desc: After asking the Bundys to watch their house for the day, Marcy and Steve return to find a big hole where their house once stood.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married…with Prom Queen - Pt 1
programme.desc: Peggy decides to attend hers and Al's high school reunion. After spending $2,800 of Al’s hard earned money, she makes a desperate effort to get herself elected prom queen.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married…with Prom Queen - Pt 2
programme.desc: Peggy stands to lose the crown to Connie Bender, until Al finally decides to stand up to Connie's husband Jack. After Bud and Kelly crash the party, Peggy enlist their help to rig the election.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Computer Show
programme.desc: The Bundys buy a computer, which serves no purpose other than a hat rack. But what nobody knows is that the computer can talk. But only to Al.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Dateless Amigo
programme.desc: After his two best friends find dates for themselves, Bud desperately seeks any girl that will date him. Meanwhile, Al comes up with a million dollar invention for a shoe salesmen's convention.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Life's a Beach
programme.desc: The Bundys spend a day at the beach.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Brothers
programme.desc: The IMF turns itself into a surgical team to operate on a tyrannical ruler who has imprisoned the rightful king, his twin brother, on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 1)
programme.desc: Guest stars Noel Harrison and Diane Baker are drawn into a daring IMF charade that uses a trained falcon to help in a crown jewel theft in the first of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 2)
programme.desc: Barney is blinded in an accident, a bride-to-be is buried alive and Paris poses as a man he is unaware is marked for death in the second of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 3)
programme.desc: A trained falcon is summoned in a last-ditch rescue attempt when Jim Phelps finds his IMF endangered by a traitor's assassination plot in the last of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Time Bomb
programme.desc: To head off a threatened atomic blast, Jim Phelps gains entry to a top secret nuclear plant by posing as a temperamental artist with guest star Barbara Luna as his model on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Amnesiac
programme.desc: As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Chico
programme.desc: A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Terror
programme.desc: To calm a Middle East trouble spot, the IMF tries to keep a man in prison long enough to make it look as though he is trying to break out on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Gitano
programme.desc: The IMF hides a young prince from assassins by disguising him as a gypsy girl, then Paris sets out to betray the boy to his pursuers on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Crane
programme.desc: After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Death Squad
programme.desc: Jim Phelps leads the IMF to aid one of its own members when Barney is arrested and marked for execution by a sadistic police chief (guest star Pernell Roberts) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Martyr
programme.desc: To keep a student congress from being used as a rubber stamp by a repressive premier (John Larch), the IMF sets Phelps up for capture so he can betray Paris as a turncoat student leader on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Butterfly
programme.desc: The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unga journalisten Tamara Drewe återvänder till sina rötter på den engelska landsbygden för att sälja sitt barndomshem efter att hennes mamma dött.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek och Ian Somerhalder ger liv och skratt åt denna ärliga, vågade titt på sociala och sexuella relationer på college.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: Dating Amber

programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 628

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 630

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 631

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 705

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 707
